description:
Wakasa-sensei and Okiya Subaru chaperone Conan and the Detective Boys to a beach in Shizuoka that is running a collab with Kamen Yaiba. After enjoying the beach hut`s collab menu, the kids play in the water while the adults sit on the beach... when suddenly, a murder is discovered at the beach hut!
Source: crunchyroll

titles.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part 1)
探偵団と二人の引率者 (前編)
